description: The tab bar of the main-dock layout, with a Soft Surface dock for pinned side panels (Files and Git by default) plus a Side/Modal toggle, a categorized Apps launcher for other panels, tab views and tools, and a dynamic chip for open unpinned panels. The gear menu sets Density and pinned bar buttons.

settings.label: Button density
settings.hint: Auto shows the names of the bar buttons from 1280 px of bar width. Shared by the Kanban bar and the Dock bar.

settings.label: Where panels open
settings.hint: Auto opens a panel at the side when the window is wide, else in a dialog. Shared by the Kanban bar and the Dock bar.
